_comment: The single source of every pinned native version. Every other copy (Gradle, Package.swift, example app, CI) is asserted against this file by test/native_versions_test.dart.

flutter.provenance: The plugin is SwiftPM-only (no podspec), so `flutter pub get` fails on Linux/Windows before 3.41.0 ('only Swift Package Manager compatible'); measured on CI across 3.27-3.38, first passing release 3.41.0. For reference, competitor floors (pub.dev, 2026-10-20): Sentry 3.44, Firebase/Datadog 3.27, Bugsnag/Shake/Embrace 3.10, Instabug 1.17.

android.provenance: Maven Central latest, 2026-11-12 (moved from 7.5.0 / plugin 4.1.0; 7.5.1 is a fix release: no API change except the new Bugsee.getSdkVersion()/getSdkBuild(); options, report enums and the vh request are unchanged). Gradle plugin must be >= 4.0.7 (workbook 1.4); 4.1.1 is the latest release, tag v4.1.1. sdkBuild is the commit the SDK prints in its banner (`Bugsee Android SDK 7.5.1 [7b2ce1f52]`, tag v7.5.1; read from the tag, not yet from a run): the device verification harness (scripts/device) matches it, because a version string alone cannot tell two builds of the same version apart (workbook 9.1.1).

jdk.provenance: Gradle 8.14 in the Flutter template cannot parse JDK 25 (Android Studio's bundled JBR); use 17 or 21.

ios.provenance: Stable 7.0.1 (moved from 7.0.0 on 2026-11-03): tag 7.0.1 of bugsee/spm (15553bd) and bugsee/feedback-spm (0d20338), SDK source `origin/release@5c6b9d9db` of bugsee/bugsee-cocoa (the iOS source repository has no 7.x tag). sdkBuild is what the SDK prints in its banner (`Bugsee IOS SDK ver:7.0.1 build:5c6b9d9db-8`: the commit and its count), read from the string in the 7.0.1 binary of the tag's xcframework (not yet from a run: the device verification harness, workbook 9.1.1, matches it on the next run). 7.0.1 over 7.0.0: the wrapper SPI headers are unchanged in shape; the options manifest differs only in generatedAt/sdkVersion. Earlier builds: 7.0.0 `2b88480fa-7`, beta7 `9854b7e50-15`.

feedback.provenance: The optional in-app chat, a separate package (PLAN.md D4) mirroring the native split. Its Android artifact is published at the same version as android.sdk (Maven Central, 2026-11-12: bugsee-android-feedback 7.5.1, which depends on bugsee-android 7.5.1); its iOS product is BugseeFeedback of feedbackSpmUrl at ios.sdk (it pins bugsee/spm exactly to the same tag). The feedback package's Gradle and Package.swift repeat these pins as literals (a published copy has no native-versions.json next to it) and test/feedback_package_drift_test.dart compares them.

pigeon.provenance: pub.dev, published 2026-10-07 (latest at the time was 29.0.11, 2026-10-20); needs Dart ^3.11.0. Not a dependency of the plugin (it requires meta >=1.18, Flutter 3.41.0 ships 1.17.0): it runs from the pure-Dart package in pigeons/, locked by pigeons/pubspec.lock.

optionsManifest.provenance: Both SDKs publish an immutable options-manifest.json per release (bugsee/specs sdk/options, manifestVersion 1), generated from the live option registry: android/7.5.1.json (generatedAt 2026-11-11) and ios/7.0.1.json (generatedAt 2026-11-03), android fetched 2026-11-12, ios 2026-11-03, vendored verbatim as android.json / ios.json in fixtureDir. `dart scripts/sync_option_manifests.dart --check` (weekly, native-pins.yml) refetches and diffs; everything else reads the committed copies offline.
